name: EIA regional demand · ISNE / PJM / CAISO
purpose: Regional electricity-demand context in Test scenarios. Shows historical demand plus a declared facility load; does not assign that demand to a county.
acquisition: Official EIA bulk download; API reconciliation for a missing PJM adjusted record.
storage: Repository: data/releases/comparison-2025.json. Published browser copy: dashboard-data.json → regions / timestamps.
processing: Hourly series aligned to a common UTC year; hour-ending labels converted to interval starts. Browser adds scenario load.
review: Frozen historical context; does not establish spare capacity.

name: EIA-930 ISNE qualified snapshot
purpose: Input to the fixed ISNE scheduling and forecasting experiments.
acquisition: Paginated EIA v2 hourly API requests; source bytes checked and normalized.
storage: Published browser copy: dashboard-data.json → isne. Source register: registers/sources.json. Exact raw snapshot location is not included in this Site.
processing: Normalized hourly intervals retain publisher flags; frozen experiment summaries are packaged for the browser.

name: Census county boundaries
purpose: County map shapes and county identifiers.
acquisition: Downloaded official 2025 Census cartographic boundaries; transformed into the county map release.
processing: Boundary geometry joined to county attributes; FIPS identifiers preserve county identity.
review: Prototype map; colors are workforce measures, not suitability scores.

name: BLS LAUS supplied workforce workbook
purpose: Historical national workforce acquisition retained in project records. Its nonpilot county metrics are not published or used by the current map.
acquisition: Supplied BLS workbook imported into the county spine.
storage: Repository: data/county/county_spine.csv and data/county/county_spine_manifest.json. Published: county-screen.geojson.
processing: County workforce attributes joined to boundaries. Original supplied workbook location is not recorded in this Site.
review: Candidate review status despite display use; newer pilot data are separate.

name: BLS LAUS pilot API series
purpose: Workforce map colors and county detail for the enabled pilot counties only. Published map values and detail use the same released period.
acquisition: BLS public API; raw response and acquisition index retained by acquisition workflow.
storage: Repository: data/pilot/daq-17/laus_county_monthly.csv and manifest.json. Published: dashboard-data.json → counties.
processing: Parses monthly measures, preserves unavailable values and compares revised August 2025 values with supplied data.
review: Candidate; compare matching months before drawing conclusions.

name: BLS QCEW pilot county slices
purpose: Workplace employment context for the three pilot counties.
acquisition: Downloads county CSV slices from BLS QCEW open-data API.
storage: Repository: data/pilot/daq-18/qcew_2026_q1_county.csv and manifest.json. Published: dashboard-data.json → counties.
processing: Checks county and quarter; retains disclosure codes and missing values. Workplace jobs differ from resident workforce.

name: EIA-861 utility relationships
purpose: County details and comparison brief: reported utilities and utility/state grid-area candidates.
acquisition: Official EIA-861 2025 ZIP downloaded, then pilot relationship tables extracted.
storage: Repository: data/pilot/eia861-2025/county-utility.csv and utility-ba.csv. Published: dashboard-data.json → counties.
processing: Matches reported county/utility records; grid-area candidates remain at utility/state level.
review: Acquired, unaccepted; parcel service and county-to-grid assignment remain unresolved.

name: FERC Form 714 ISNE filing
purpose: Data library planning-area forecasts and comparison context; separate from EIA balancing-authority demand.
acquisition: Downloaded FERC XBRL filing; qualification script parses planning-area hourly records.
storage: Repository: registers/ferc714_qualification.json. Published: dashboard-data.json → ferc. Exact raw filing path is not included in this Site.
processing: Preserves planning-area definition and local-year offset; forecast values are displayed as planning context.
period: 2025 filing; forecast years shown in chart
review: Conditional; not connection headroom or an accepted cross-region forecast comparison.

name: PJM / CAISO / ISO-NE planning documents
purpose: Links and acquisition fingerprints in Data library. Not inputs to the regional added-load calculator.
acquisition: Direct PDF / HTML / XLSX downloads from publishers.
storage: Repository acquisition index: registers/acquisition_observations_2026_10_25.json. Published metadata: dashboard-data.json → planning_sources. Raw documents are not bundled in this Site.
processing: Catalogs retrieval time and file fingerprint; no common capacity metric inferred.
period: Acquired Oct 25, 2026; individual document vintages vary

name: NOAA station weather
purpose: Nearby-station weather context in the historical regional release; not an active cooling model in the hosted Scenario lab.
storage: Underlying release: data/releases/comparison-2025.json. Raw acquisition folder is not included in this Site.
processing: Station summaries provide weather context; hosted scenario uses the user-entered PUE.
review: Not evidence of water service or validated cooling performance.

name: NYIS one-week demand samples
purpose: Source-method samples in the register; New York is not one of the three displayed grid regions.
acquisition: EIA v2 API sample requests recorded in the source register.
storage: Metadata: registers/sources.json; published dashboard-data.json → sources. Raw sample paths not included in this Site.
processing: Retains sample periods and fingerprints; not used in the three-region comparison.

name: ACS / USGS / FEMA / EPA and local service evidence
purpose: Potential community, water, hazard, emissions and site-service evidence.
acquisition: Future acquisition or qualification; methods depend on each source.
storage: No integrated scoring dataset in this hosted release.
processing: No missing values are filled or treated as favorable.
review: Not used for scoring or final site recommendations.
